nodes.question: In the edited image, is the original mug from the source image visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: pass: The mug corresponding to the source mug is identifiable in the edited image and is visibly to the right of the headphones. fail: The source mug is identifiable and visibly is not to the right of the headphones. unknown: The source mug's identity or its position relative to the headphones cannot be determined.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Track the blue mug that is left of the headphones in the source; do not count a different mug on the right as the requested mug. Use unknown if the source mug cannot be reliably identified in the edit.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is there visible evidence that the original mug itself moved toward the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: pass: The source mug can be identified in the edited image and visible comparison establishes movement toward the headphones' right. fail: The source mug is identifiable and visible evidence establishes that it did not move toward the requested position. unknown: The mug's identity or movement cannot be determined.
nodes.binding: Track the blue mug left of the headphones in the source across to the edited image. Assess movement of that same mug relative to the headphones, not the appearance of another mug on the right. Do not infer absence of movement from blur or uncertainty.

nodes.question: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
nodes.criteria: Apply the original rubric to R1. Return complete when s1 establishes that the original mug is to the right of the headphones. If completion is not established, return partial when s2 establishes movement of the original mug toward the requested position. Return absent only when evidence establishes no requested progress. Otherwise return unknown. Unrelated edits do not count; unknown evidence is not failure.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. You receive no reference label or optimization feedback. Return status, evidence, reported confidence (0..1 or null), and used_dependency_ids naming every supplied context check_id exactly once in saved order.
Supports receive source and edited images. Answer only the saved proposition using its binding and criteria. Use pass/fail/unknown. Context is advisory unless listed in required_dependencies. A negative context observation is usable evidence. Unknown, skipped, or invalid context is not a failure and must not stop an independent image inspection. Inspect the images yourself; do not repeat a parent's answer. Return unknown when the relevant fact cannot be established. Confidence reports confidence in this answer, not calibrated correctness.
Fulfillment receives NO images. Use only saved support evidence, original instruction/rubric and frozen composition criteria. Return complete/partial/absent/unknown. Supporting passes answer specific propositions, not a count of completed edits. Their polarity can differ. Apply saved alternatives: optional uncertainty need not prevent a known outcome, but a required unresolved fact makes that outcome unresolved. Never invent a visual fact or convert missing evidence into failure. A conditional skip is not non-applicability. All applicable requested outcomes complete gives yes; no requested progress gives no; known progress short of completion gives partial. Unrelated changes are not progress.
